description: Belgian bidding-zone day-ahead wholesale energy prices aligned to physical 15-minute UTC intervals.

columns.da_price_eur_mwh: Belgian day-ahead energy price in EUR/MWh.
columns.native_resolution: Source market-time-unit duration: PT60M or PT15M.
columns.upsampled_from_hourly: True when one hourly source price was repeated over four quarter-hours.
columns.source_file: Original ENTSO-E GUI Energy Prices CSV filename.

source.source_files: GUI_ENERGY_PRICES annual CSV exports for 2015 through 2026

resolution.method: Hourly prices are repeated over their four physical quarter-hours; they are not interpolated.

notes: The UTC index avoids ambiguity at Belgian daylight-saving-time changes.
Negative prices are valid input and must not be clipped.
Prices are wholesale day-ahead references without supplier margins, imbalance fees, taxes, multipliers, or other contract-specific adjustments.
The complete project-level source Parquet should not be copied into every simulation folder; record its hash and retain the selected aligned prices in the run artifacts.
